name: Eglon
summary: A king of Moab whom the LORD made strong against Israel when they did evil, and Israel served him eighteen years. He was a very fat man, and Ehud killed him in his summer parlour.

key_moments.title: Rules Over Israel Eighteen Years
key_moments.description: When Israel did evil again, the LORD made Eglon strong against them. He joined with Ammon and Amalek, struck Israel and took the city of palm trees, and Israel served him eighteen years.

key_moments.title: Stabbed by Ehud
key_moments.description: Eglon was sitting alone in his summer parlour when Ehud said he had a message from God for him. As Eglon rose from his seat, Ehud drove a dagger into his belly so deep that the fat closed over the blade.

key_moments.title: Found Dead by His Servants
key_moments.description: Ehud locked the parlour doors and slipped away. Eglon's servants waited outside until they were ashamed, then opened the doors with a key and found their lord dead on the floor.
